title: Members of the Explosive Ordnance Disposal Section place TNT cans C4 explosive on defective ammunition
description: Members of the Explosive Ordnance Disposal Section, 184th Ord Bn, renovate damaged and outdated ammunition at the explosive ordnance disposal area, 16 miles northwest of Qui Nhon. Defective fuses are removed from mortar rounds and replaced with new fuses. The defective ones are destroyed. Members of the EOD Section place 1/2 lb TNT cans and composition C-4 plastic explosive on the ammunition stack. NARA 111-CCV-190-CC36059
author: SP5 Robert R. Ellis
